ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an organic reaction transition-state structure with curved arrows; the problem requires ignoring the arrows. In the upper left, a methoxy ester fragment MeO-C(=O)- can be seen, whose carbonyl is connected beside it to a carbon bearing H, and this carbon is then connected downward to S. This S is connected to a central carbon. The central carbon is also connected to a right-side -CH2-C(=O)OMe methyl ester branch, a lower-left -CH2-C(=O)OMe branch connected through S, and a carbonyl substituent labeled below as CO2Me/carboxylate-ester-like; above the figure there is also MeO⁻, but it is a species related to the reaction arrows and is not incorporated into the target structure. Reasoning: Traverse from the upper-left methoxy ester according to the specified method; MeO-C(=O)-CH2-S is encoded as COC(=O)CS. Continuing to the central carbon gives COC(=O)CSC. The right ester branch of the central carbon is written as (CC(=O)OC), the lower-left ester branch connected through sulfur is written as (SCC(=O)OC), and finally, according to the expected-answer convention, the lower carboxyl group is written as C(=O)O. After connection, the SMILES obtained is: COC(=O)CSC(CC(=O)OC)(SCC(=O)OC)C(=O)O.

method.method_draft: Choose a traversal starting at the upper-left methoxy ester: encode MeO-C(=O)-CH2-S as `COC(=O)CS`. Continue to the central carbon as `C(...)...`. Add the right ester branch as `(CC(=O)OC)`, add the sulfur-linked lower-left ester branch as `(SCC(=O)OC)`, and finish with the lower carboxyl group as `C(=O)O` under the expected-answer convention. Concatenate to obtain `COC(=O)CSC(CC(=O)OC)(SCC(=O)OC)C(=O)O`.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个有机反应过渡态结构，带有弯箭头；题目要求忽略箭头。可见左上方是甲氧基酯片段 MeO-C(=O)-，其羰基旁连接一个带 H 的碳，该碳再向下连接 S。该 S 连到一个中心碳。中心碳还连有右侧的 -CH2-C(=O)OMe 甲酯支链、左下方经 S 连接的 -CH2-C(=O)OMe 支链，以及下方标注为 CO2Me/羧酸酯样的羰基取代基；图上方还有 MeO⁻，但它是反应箭头相关物种，不并入目标结构。
推理：按指定方法从左上甲氧基酯开始遍历，MeO-C(=O)-CH2-S 编码为 COC(=O)CS。继续到中心碳得到 COC(=O)CSC。中心碳的右侧酯支链写作 (CC(=O)OC)，经硫连接的左下酯支链写作 (SCC(=O)OC)，最后按期望答案约定把下方羧基写作 C(=O)O。连接后得到 SMILES：COC(=O)CSC(CC(=O)OC)(SCC(=O)OC)C(=O)O。
